intended_object: This is the identity map between the type synonym `glTraceTwistedYoungWedge R a c` and the exterior power ⋀^{Σa}(R^{ι×Fin(Σa)}) that it is built on, as an R-linear equivalence. The docstring and module docs say it exists so that later statements can refer to the carrier without unfolding its definition.
explanation: The body is just `GlTraceTwist.linearEquiv`, and that is built from the identity additive equivalence, with `map_smul'` proved by `rfl`. In other words, it is the identity map on the underlying R-module of a type synonym. The library uses it so that it never has to unfold that synonym. It is an implementation device for working with type synonyms. Mathematically, the twisted module and the exterior power are the same R-module, so there is no separate mathematical object here to compare against. The definition is correct for its purpose: it really is the identity linear equivalence onto the module that the synonym wraps.
